newsitem.title: UK: UK shares close higher as Wall St rally continues.
newsitem.headline: UK shares close higher as Wall St rally continues.

text.p: British shares closed higher for a second day on Wednesday, as pharmaceuticals were spurred higher by rising U.S. drug stocks and market nerves were steadied by a continued rebound on Wall Street.
Extending its bounce from Tuesday's near seven-week low, the FTSE 100 index closed 43.7 points higher at 4,640.0, with gainers in a near two-to-one majority.

Dealers said the market's recent six-day tumble had lured some bargain-hunters but pointed out that price gains were exaggerated since many market-makers were running short books ahead of next Wednesday's budget.
